healthyDefinition: No hard data/runtime gate may fail. Episode reconciliation and future final snapshots may remain IN_PROGRESS before their deadlines but must never be hidden.

marketCoverage.detail: Current spread/total coverage from canonical board.

deepDiveEvidence.detail: Every game must have a structured dossier; source-limited completion is explicit and does not masquerade as full evidence.

unifiedUpsetResearch.detail: Research artifact week=2; routing remains isolated from production fair/model/Bet Activation Gate/ledger/units.

marketMovers.detail: Current derived mover set remains governed from the canonical board/reference history.

underdogSpecial.detail: Canonical +3.5-to-+7 screen remains governed separately; no expert residual can activate it by itself.

longshotUpsetLab.detail: Canonical longshot research remains governed separately; no expert residual can alter routing by itself.

expertEpisodeInventory.detail: First-party inventory is current for this pass with no new incremental package, but data/expert-weekly.json is not demonstrably losslessly synchronized with newer governed episode-audit records. Exact records remain preserved in audits; do not truncate the primary ledger from a partial read.

canonicalGameJoins.detail: Derived selected-week layers use canonical game IDs; expert/audit records remain separately reconciled and any unmatched required item is a hard ingestion failure.

productionVerifier.detail: Live portal verification remains separately required after runtime changes.

preKickoffSnapshots.detail: Immutable 60–90 minute final snapshots remain required individually through kickoff.

currentPriorityQueue: Resolve lossless synchronization of data/expert-weekly.json with governed episode audits
notificationPolicy: Notify only for material handicap evidence, material confidence/disagreement change, official activation or unresolved hard gate failure.
